# Product roadmap — 2026

Dated 2026-08-21.

## Committed for this year

- **Customer data export ships in Q3 2026.** Bulk export of a customer's full
  record set, self-serve, no support ticket required. This is committed to two
  named accounts and is on the Q3 release plan.
- Single sign-on lands alongside it.
- Audit log retention rises from 90 days to one year.

## Owners

Export is owned by the platform team. Retention is owned by security.
